notes: Design choices: (1) The pack write and the sign-off are two case-log entries (pack_written, then signed_off), both appended after the rename inside one writer hold. If the log refuses pack_written, the renamed pack is removed. If pack_written is recorded but signed_off is not (a file-system failure between the two appends), the pack stays and a retry for that snapshot is refused as already written; the person previews again for a new snapshot. (2) memo.md is exactly the guarded preview text. The sign-off is recorded in evidence.json and the log, not in memo.md, so the memo still passes the guard (P14). (3) evidence.json here is a first version; T25 owns the full evidence v1 schema and monthly.csv, and T26 owns record.html. (4) Leftover packs/.part-* folders are removed at the start of each sign-off, while the case is held. (5) tests/test_workspace_summary.py's P8 helper allow-listed the page's form actions; I added /preview, the new form, to that list. Nothing else in that test changed.
